prompts.name: hammer
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original painted fantasy mobile-game forge VFX asset. Transparent RGBA background, no background whatsoever, no text, numbers, characters, gear tile, grids, cell borders or watermark. Painterly luminous tapered brush shapes, sky-white tiny cores, molten gold ember orange rose-gold edges against cool navy steel; intentional asymmetry, sparse negative space, phone readable. One single beautifully painted forge hammer sprite centered in a square canvas, upright vertical wood handle with dark leather wraps, handle lower end exactly at normalized (0.50,0.94), steel head horizontal across upper quarter, cool navy faceted forged steel with restrained gold inlay, warm reflected highlights. Entire hammer fits within 8% margins. No trail, no sparks, no surrounding glow. Actual transparent background.

prompts.name: result_glow_cyan
prompts.prompt: Original painted fantasy game result glow flipbook, actual transparent background RGBA. Arrange exactly SIX sprites in THREE COLUMNS and TWO ROWS, equal cells, generous separation and transparent margins, no lines grids borders text numbers or gear. Each sprite a WIDE LOW 2:1 soft calm pale cyan bloom, with delicate EIGHT POINT sky-white star slightly left of center and warm gold tiny tips. Restrained luminous painterly tapered rays. Cell order reading across then down: quiet onset, gentle peak, luminous peak, settle, soft, nearly faded still. Never let rays or bloom reach cell boundary; each sprite must fit within central 60% of cell. No overlapping adjacent sprites. No opaque discs. No other objects.
